scenes.say: Quick test. Cover one eye right now. Is everything just as clear?

scenes.en: Look at a far clock or sign with each eye.
scenes.say: Now switch. Look at a far clock or sign board, first with one eye, then the other.

scenes.en: The brain blends both eyes. The stronger eye hides the weaker one.
scenes.say: Why didn't you notice before? Your brain blends both eyes into one picture, so the stronger eye covers for the weaker one.

scenes.en: In children, a lazy eye is easiest to treat when found early.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகளுக்கு சோம்பேறிக் கண்ணை சிறு வயதிலேயே சரிசெய்வது எளிது
scenes.say: Did you know? In children, a lazy eye is easiest to treat when it is found early. That's why every child needs an eye test.

scenes.en: Uncorrected power, cataract or a retina problem.
scenes.say: In adults, one blurry eye can be uncorrected power, a cataract, or a retina problem. Only an eye test can tell.

scenes.en: Check each eye at home. Note blur, wavy lines or dark spots.
scenes.say: Do this check at home once a month. Note any blur, wavy lines, or dark spots.

scenes.en: Sudden blur or a dark patch in one eye: see an eye specialist today.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கல் இருந்தால் இன்றே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: If one eye suddenly turns blurry or shows a dark patch, see an eye specialist the same day. Otherwise, book a full eye test.
